source.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally Can Be More Effective Than Scaling Model Parameters

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: Snell and colleagues also compare a smaller model with additional inference against a larger model sampled once. Their cross-over analysis balances pretraining and expected lifetime inference FLOPs. It is not a guarantee about one request’s latency or bill. Include difficulty-estimation cost and workload size before applying that kind of compute comparison.
teaching.moment: Read the FLOPs-matched crossover between a smaller model’s additional inference and a larger model sampled once.
teaching.scope: Retain difficulty bins, oracle-policy scope and lifetime inference/pretraining ratio; this is not a per-request latency or price guarantee.
teaching.caption: A lifetime FLOPs comparison with oracle difficulty bins; these are not latency curves.
